taxonomies.name: Smart Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Wi-Fi or wireless enabled dimmer switches that can be controlled remotely and integrate with smart home systems, e.g. app-controlled dimmers, voice-activated dimmers, hub-connected dimmers

taxonomies.name: Slide Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with sliding control mechanism for adjusting light levels, e.g. linear slide controls, vertical slide dimmers, slide bar dimmers

taxonomies.name: Toggle Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with toggle-style control mechanism, e.g. flip toggle dimmers, switch-style dimmers, traditional toggle controls

taxonomies.name: Rotary Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with rotating knob control for light adjustment, e.g. dial control dimmers, twist knob dimmers, circular control switches

taxonomies.name: Rocker Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches with rocker-style control mechanism, e.g. paddle-style dimmers, rocker button controls, press-style dimmer switches

taxonomies.name: Remote Control Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches that include separate wireless remote control functionality, e.g. magnetic remote dimmers, handheld remote controls, wireless dimmer remotes

taxonomies.name: Companion Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Dimmer switches designed specifically for multi-location setups requiring master switches, e.g. add-on switches, auxiliary dimmers, secondary location controls

taxonomies.name: Universal Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Basic dimmer switches with standard functionality for general lighting control, e.g. single pole dimmers, three-way dimmers, standard light dimmers

taxonomies.name: Standard Dimmer Switch
taxonomies.definition: Traditional wall-mounted dimmer switches without smart connectivity for controlling light brightness, e.g. slide dimmers, rotary dimmers, electronic dimmers

taxonomies.name: Smart On Off Switch
taxonomies.definition: Wi-Fi or wireless enabled on/off switches without dimming capability that integrate with smart home systems, e.g. app-controlled switches, voice-activated switches, hub-connected switches

taxonomies.name: Single Pole Switch
taxonomies.definition: Basic on/off switches for controlling lights from one location, e.g. toggle switches, paddle switches, rocker switches

taxonomies.name: Multi Gang Switch
taxonomies.definition: Switch assemblies with multiple individual switches in one unit, e.g. double switches, triple switches, duplex switches

taxonomies.name: Multi Way Switch
taxonomies.definition: Switches designed for controlling lights from multiple locations, e.g. three way switches, four way switches

taxonomies.name: Specialty Switch
taxonomies.definition: Switches designed for specific applications or with unique features beyond standard lighting control, e.g. fan control switches, illuminated switches, low voltage switches

taxonomies.name: Standard Toggle Switch
taxonomies.definition: Traditional wall-mounted switches with toggle-style actuators for basic on/off control, e.g. single pole toggles, three way toggles, lever switches

taxonomies.name: Standard Rocker Switch
taxonomies.definition: Traditional wall-mounted switches with paddle-style actuators for basic on/off control, e.g. decorator switches, paddle switches, rocker switches

taxonomies.name: Switch Accessory
taxonomies.definition: Companion devices or accessories that work with primary switches but cannot operate independently, e.g. remote controls, companion switches, add-on devices

taxonomies.name: OUT_OF_SCOPE
taxonomies.definition: Products that clearly don't belong to light switch, e.g. inline cord switches, appliance switches
